bodyDescription: This delicious paté treat made with beef is a veritable delicacy for every cat!The natural ingredients are steamed so that the nutritious properties are well preserved. Cleaning and preparing the chicken and beef, filling cans and adding toppings are all done manually. This delicious gluten-free paté treat is a real treat for any cat that loves meat !
